locations.name: River Camp
locations.label: CAMP
locations.desc: Your riverbank refuge. Build, rest, refill bottles, and manage Maya’s assignments.

locations.name: Old-growth Forest
locations.label: FOREST
locations.desc: Ancient conifers shelter fallen timber and broad fern leaves.

locations.name: Birch Grove
locations.label: GROVE
locations.desc: A sheltered grove with flexible saplings, berries, and medicinal herbs.

locations.name: River Bend
locations.label: RIVER
locations.desc: Flint and clay line the water. A wounded dire wolf stalks the nearby trail.

locations.name: Broken Ridge
locations.label: RIDGE
locations.desc: Modern wreckage is lodged among the fractured rocks. Bring Maya to salvage the Mustang alternator.

locations.name: Glowing Purple Rift
locations.label: RIFT
locations.desc: Temporary tears drop batteries, copper wire, and metal into the clearing. Crystals glow in the soil.

locations.name: Foggy Ravine
locations.label: RAVINE
locations.desc: Follow the cairns below Broken Ridge. Bring Maya, winter coats, and six rations to trace the path to the monolith.

locations.name: Glacier Peaks
locations.label: GLACIER
locations.desc: Rift crystals lie among ice-scoured rocks. Winter coats are required to reach the peaks.

locations.name: Cave Bear Den
locations.label: DEN
locations.desc: A cave bear shelters under the eastern canopy. Keep your distance or prepare to confront it.

locations.name: Woolly Rhino Meadow
locations.label: MEADOW
locations.desc: Rhinos graze beyond the river. Observe from the edge while foraging for berries and herbs.

locations.name: Wolf Totem
locations.label: TOTEM
locations.desc: Weathered wolf figures and carved pillars watch the southern forest. Their markings echo the rift.

locations.name: Rift Monolith
locations.label: MONOLITH
locations.desc: The permanent stone anchor resonates with the ravine. Solve Signals in the Mist to unlock access.

locations.name: Prehistoric Sea
locations.label: COAST
locations.desc: Explore the shore beside the river delta. Storms wash clay, stone, and stray copper onto the beach.
